fact: Enabel's final evaluation (June 2026) states PARECIGUI Phase 2 migrated 445,000 vital records into the central civil registry database, and that interoperability with PN-RAVEC has not been achieved owing to political blockages over code lists and the delayed stabilisation of the NPI format.
title: Executive summary, Pilot Project for Improving the Guinean Civil Registration System through the Catalytic Effect of Digitalization (PARECIGUI Ext Phase 2)
